name: tbm
description: Source for thebenmeadows.com — a static personal link hub (HTML + Tailwind).

scripts.build: npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./output.css --minify && node scripts/build-search-index.mjs && node scripts/build-feed.mjs && node scripts/sync-readme-mirrors.mjs
scripts.build:netlify: npm run build && rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp index.html 404.html output.css email.js theme.js search.js search-index.json me.png me.webp og.png robots.txt sitemap.xml feed.xml rss.xml _headers _redirects dist/ && cp -R favicon fonts .well-known commitments mirrors tech experiments infra essentialism search projects profiles archive dist/ && node scripts/version-css.mjs && node scripts/build-stamp.mjs && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-torrent.mjs && node scripts/check-figures.mjs && node scripts/check-onchain-code.mjs
